devdoc.details: This contract is used to define the split ratio calculating the total value locked (TVL) in the system.  The recipients are 2:  1. The TC yeld recipient. The percentage if related to the amount of TC in the system.  2. The TP yeld recipient. The percentage if related to the amount of TP in the system.

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

params.tcYeldRecipient_: address of the TC yeld recipient
params.tpYeldRecipient_: address of the TP yeld recipient

returns._0: availableToMint available amount to mint in the system, normalized to bucket(0) AC [N]
lckAC locked AC in the system, normalized to bucket(0) AC [N]

getRatio().details: The sum of the ratios must be equal to 1e18 (100%)

returns.ratios: array of ratios for each recipient [PREC]
returns.recipients: array of addresses to receive the split

returns._0: tvl total value locked in the system, normalized to bucket(0) AC [N]
targetCoverageAdj target coverage adjusted by EMA [PREC]
